mcq_choices.choice_text: P→∞ as x→−∞ and P→−∞ as x→∞
mcq_choices.rationale: The odd degree and negative leading coefficient determine opposite ends: left up and right down.

mcq_choices.choice_text: P→−∞ as x→−∞ and P→∞ as x→∞
mcq_choices.rationale: This reverses the sign set by the negative leading coefficient.

parts.prompt:

A. P→∞ at both ends
B. P→−∞ at both ends
C. P→∞ as x→−∞ and P→−∞ as x→∞
D. P→−∞ as x→−∞ and P→∞ as x→∞
